package store

import "github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"

// Factory hands back a function that itself returns *Queries -- the Queries mention is nested
// inside a func type, not the immediate result type, so it is only found by searching a
// result's whole type expression rather than matching its outermost shape.
func Factory(pool *pgxpool.Pool) func() *Queries {
	return func() *Queries {
		return &Queries{pool: pool, scopes: Scopes{"personal", "work", "client-globex"}}
	}
}
